answer: Railway signaller tenure with signal box duty logs is the check: duties served in one signal box for years. A farm faking 175 aliases needs 175 separate duty logs, each built over years, so the cost multiplies per alias instead of staying flat. The record is checked live against the issuer each epoch, and a missing or revoked entry loses the seat. The island check runs in the open: 175 fakes pay the full price 175 times, one honest agent pays once, and the ivory trail in the ledger makes the summit cost visible to everyone.
